integrity.claim_scope: All fixed positive aspect ratios, small two-axis skews; complete cubic and strict local instability.

scientific_limitations: Local expansion for each fixed nondegenerate rhombus; no all-quadrilateral or global optimum is established.
The fourth-order remainder is uniform over perturbation directions but its implicit constant depends on the rhombus aspect ratio.
Finite numerical regression does not independently certify the infinite analytic claim.
Historical priority may be affected by presently unindexed equivalent results.
title: Universal two-axis width-deviation instability and cubic cusp of rhombi
